metadata.description: Custom 5 - ID-Prioritization Dynamic Cutting: the engine polls drive units in ascending ID order and commits each move immediately. Low-ID unit 1 shuttles a continuous stream of pods back and forth across a capacity-1 choke node, while high-ID unit 99 must cross the same choke to deliver an urgent pod. Because unit 1 is always polled first, it reclaims the choke every single time step and unit 99 is cut off repeatedly. A planner that models the engine's ID ordering can hold unit 1 for a couple of steps so unit 99 slips through once.
